title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 08:05:35 最新章节：第1126章 暗流之下
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
在大虞王朝辽阔的版图上，边陲之地凉州，清水村。
晨曦初破，天边泛起一抹鱼肚白，却丝毫未能驱散空气中弥漫的燥热。
年仅十六岁的云昊，在这难耐的酷热中悠悠转醒。
一睁眼便是茅草屋顶漏下的光。
四壁斑驳的墙壁因年久失修而裂痕纵横，仿佛随时都会崩塌。
破旧的木床，随着他起身穿上打满补丁的衣物，发出咯吱咯吱的作响声。
肚子里的饥饿感比外界的炎热更加难以忍受，胃里灼烧，提醒着他现实的残酷。
云昊的耳边，还隐约回响着隔壁房间传来的微弱咳嗽声，那是他唯一的亲人——姐姐云微。
昨日，她出去挖野菜却不慎失足，摔伤了身体。
家里连请郎中的钱都没有，云微只能强忍着伤痛硬撑着，咳嗽了一夜。
云昊来到厨房，将米缸翻过来，也仅仅倒出来一小撮小黄米。
点燃柴火灶后，往锅里倒了两大瓢水，将家里最后的一小把黄米放进去，准备烧一锅粥给姐姐喝。
与其说是粥，还不如说是“水汤”
等“粥”
烧好后，云墨从锅里打捞了许久，将所有的米粒都盛在碗里，给姐姐云微端过去。
“姐你感觉咋样？我煮了粥你喝一碗。”
云昊推门进去，看到蜷缩在床上的姐姐喊叫了一声。
云微挣扎起身，脸色苍白中带着蜡黄，没有几分血色。
“姐姐无碍休息两天就好了。”
话没说完又是一阵咳嗽。

云昊连忙将碗放在一边，搀扶姐姐坐好。
“姐，我等会去找“老道爷”
问问，进山给你挖些草药。”
说话中将粥递给姐姐。
云昊口中的老道爷，在村子东边十里外的鸡鸣山道观里。
是个疯疯癫癫的老道，成天说自己在修仙悟道。
实则云昊亲眼见过，老道爷被野狗都能撵着跑的狼狈样子。
一点都不信老道爷会什么仙法，就是一个普普通通的糟老头子。
自打他记事起，老道爷就在鸡鸣山道观一个人居住着。
道观压根就没香火，吃饭也是饥一餐饱一餐。
爹娘还在世的时候，娘是道观的信徒，云昊小时候跟着娘去过道观上香，因此和老道爷相熟。
在云昊心里老道爷唯一的优点是能识文断字辨别草药，懂一点点粗浅医理。
村里人有个啥疾病，也都会去道观问问老道爷挖些草药治病。
虽然很多时候，老道爷瞧病都不准，但穷人家请不起郎中，也只死马当活马医。
云昊时不时会跑去道观听老道爷讲故事，顺便跟他学认字和草药辨别。
他本以为姐姐昨天摔伤，休息一晚就能好，现在看来更严重了，不得不去找老道爷，希望能给姐姐挖点草药治治。
再一个，家徒四壁，挖药的工具都没一把。
还得找老道爷去借。
云微一怔道：“都是姐姐没用，拖累你了，小昊眼下姐姐动不了身子，我知道家里没米了，山里危险，你别进山，今天去就小河边挖点野草根煮着吃。
至于姐姐的身体你别担心，千万别进山，尤其是别去坠星岭，大山里有猛兽……”
content_en:
In the vast territory of the Dayu Dynasty, there was Qingshui Village in Liangzhou, a borderland.
The morning light had just begun to break, and a touch of fish belly white appeared on the horizon, but it did nothing to dispel the heat in the air.
Yunhao, who was only sixteen years old, slowly woke up in the unbearable heat.
As soon as I opened my eyes, I saw the light leaking from the thatched roof.
The mottled walls were cracked due to age and disrepair, as if they would collapse at any time.
The old wooden bed creaked as he stood up and put on his patched clothes.
The hunger in his stomach was more unbearable than the heat outside, and the burning in his stomach reminded him of the cruelty of reality.
Yun Hao's ears still vaguely echoed with the faint cough coming from the next room. That was his only relative - his sister Yun Wei.
Yesterday, she went out to dig wild vegetables but accidentally slipped and fell.
The family didn't even have the money to hire a doctor, so Yun Wei could only endure the pain and cough all night long.
Yun Hao came to the kitchen, turned the rice vat over, and only poured out a handful of small yellow rice.
After lighting the firewood stove, I poured two large ladles of water into the pot, put the last handful of yellow rice in the house, and prepared to cook a pot of porridge for my sister.
Rather than saying it is porridge, it is better to say it is "water soup"
Waiting for "porridge"
After it was cooked, Yun Mo fished it out of the pot for a long time, put all the rice grains in a bowl, and brought it to his sister Yun Wei.
"Sister, how do you feel? I've cooked porridge and you have a bowl."
Yunhao pushed the door open and shouted when he saw his sister curled up on the bed.
Yun Wei struggled to get up, his face pale and sallow, with no trace of blood.
"Sister, it's okay to rest for two days."
Before he finished speaking, he coughed again.
Yunhao quickly put the bowl aside and helped his sister sit down.
"Sister, I'll go find the "Old Taoist" later.
Ask, go into the mountains and dig some herbs for you. "
While talking, he handed the porridge to his sister.
The old Taoist master Yun Hao spoke of was in the Jiming Mountain Taoist Temple ten miles east of the village.
He is a crazy old Taoist who says all day long that he is cultivating immortality and enlightenment.
In fact, Yun Hao had seen with his own eyes how embarrassed the old Taoist was even driven away by wild dogs.
I don't believe that the old Taoist master has any magical powers at all, he is just an ordinary bad old man.
For as long as he can remember, the old Taoist master has lived alone in Jimingshan Taoist Temple.
The Taoist temple has no popularity at all, and eating only means one meal when you are hungry and one meal when you are full.
When his father and mother were still alive, his mother was a believer in the Taoist temple. When Yunhao was a child, he followed his mother to the Taoist temple to offer incense, so he became familiar with the old Taoist master.
In Yunhao's mind, the only advantage of the old Taoist is that he can read and identify herbs and understands a little bit of superficial medical science.
If people in the village have any disease, they will go to the Taoist temple to ask the old Taoist master for some herbs to treat the disease.
Although in many cases, the old Taoist doctor was not accurate in seeing a doctor, poor families could not afford to hire a doctor, so they had to treat a dead horse as a live doctor.
From time to time, Yunhao would go to the Taoist temple to listen to the old Taoist master telling stories, and learn to read and identify herbs from him.
He originally thought that his sister had fallen down yesterday and would be fine with a night's rest. But now it seemed to be more serious, so he had to go to the old Taoist, hoping to dig up some herbs for his sister's treatment.
Another one, the family is bare and has no tools for digging medicine.
You have to ask the old Taoist to borrow it.
Yun Wei was startled and said: "It's all my sister who is useless and dragging you down. Xiaohao, my sister can't move now. I know there is no rice at home and the mountains are dangerous. Don't go into the mountains. Today I will dig some wild grass roots by the river and cook them."
As for my sister's health, don't worry about it. Don't go into the mountains, especially Falling Star Ridge. There are ferocious beasts in the mountains..."
